interpretation_limits: These are distinct characteristic initial-value spacetimes and are not a single observer's radial trajectory or a physical time evolution of mass versus radius.
Even convergent local charged Hawking-mass estimates do not establish late-time Cauchy-horizon mass inflation. No Price tail or advanced null coordinate to infinity evolved.
The radius guard .4006 is chosen numerically (0.05% of ideal horizon coordinate gap), not a physical horizon, material safety condition or fundamental constant.
Only resolution escalation on globally uniform grids was implemented; there is NO locally adaptive mesh refinement.
Absolute coordinate Cuu/Cvv and mass-flux residual values are gauge-and-grid-dependent numerical diagnostics, not direct observation errors.
The physical RN inner horizon may be unstable under perturbations, and continuing an ideal background past it is not justified by this bounded simulation.
Reissner-Nordström Q is assumed; it is not Kerr spin or observed galactic electric charge.
24! combinatorial address and 729 scalar field sample grid remain computational selectors, not objects or clocks.
Near-horizon numerical proximity does not prove solution convergence at the limiting Cauchy horizon itself, stable extension, or any physical center.
